name: Ellis AI Studio — Calendar Content Automation

parameters.jsCode: const event=$input.first().json; const description=String(event.description||''); const pairs=Object.fromEntries([...description.matchAll(/^\s*([A-Z_]+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$/gm)].map((m)=>[m[1],m[2]])); const contentId=pairs.CONTENT_ID; const start=event.start?.dateTime||event.start?.date; if(!String(event.summary||'').startsWith('PRE-POST |')||pairs.STATUS!=='READY'||!contentId||!start||new Date(start)>new Date()) return []; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.content=store.content||{}; const prior=store.content[contentId]; if(prior?.status==='published'||prior?.status==='awaiting_approval'||prior?.status==='approved') return []; const required=['PLATFORM','TOPIC','AUDIENCE','GOAL','CTA','WEBSITE','APPROVAL_REQUIRED','STATUS']; const missing=required.filter((key)=>!pairs[key]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Calendar event '+(event.id||'unknown')+' is missing: '+missing.join(', ')); store.content[contentId]={status:'generating',eventId:event.id,startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),retries:(prior?.retries||0)}; return [{json:{contentId,eventId:event.id,start,platform:pairs.PLATFORM.toLowerCase(),topic:pairs.TOPIC,audience:pairs.AUDIENCE,goal:pairs.GOAL,cta:pairs.CTA,website:pairs.WEBSITE,approvalRequired:pairs.APPROVAL_REQUIRED,sourceDescription:description}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:'gpt-4.1-mini',temperature:0.2,text:{format:{type:'json_schema',name:'ellis_linkedin_caption',strict:true,schema:{type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['caption'],properties:{caption:{type:'string'}}}}},input:[{role:'system',content:[{type:'input_text',text:"You write polished LinkedIn posts for Ellis AI Studio. Use only the provided facts. Focus on the business problem, practical outcome, time savings, cost reduction, and growth opportunity when supported by the input. Never invent testimonials, clients, metrics, or results. Return JSON with only caption. Keep it credible, concise, and end with the supplied CTA."}]},{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:JSON.stringify($json)}]}]}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Parse and Guard Content').first().json; const response=$input.first().json; const text=response.output_text||response.output?.flatMap((x)=>x.content||[]).find((x)=>x.type==='output_text')?.text; const parsed=JSON.parse(text); if(!parsed.caption) throw new Error('OpenAI returned no LinkedIn caption.'); return [{json:{...source,caption:parsed.caption}}];

const item=$input.first().json; const token=crypto.randomUUID()+crypto.randomUUID(); const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.approvals=store.approvals||{}; store.content=store.content||{}; store.approvals[token]={contentId:item.contentId,caption:item.caption,expiresAt:Date.now()+7*24*60*60*1000,status:'pending'}; store.content[item.contentId]={...(store.content[item.contentId]||{}),status:'awaiting_approval',finalCaption:item.caption}; const base="https://ellisaistudio.app.n8n.cloud"; return [{json:{...item,approveUrl:base+'/webhook/ellis-content-approve?token='+encodeURIComponent(token),rejectUrl:base+'/webhook/ellis-content-reject?token='+encodeURIComponent(token),revisionUrl:base+'/webhook/ellis-content-revision?token='+encodeURIComponent(token)}}];

Links expire in seven days.' }}

parameters.jsCode: const token=$input.first().json.query?.token; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); const record=store.approvals?.[token]; if(!record||record.expiresAt<Date.now()||record.status!=='pending') throw new Error('This approval link is invalid, expired, or already used.'); record.status='approved'; store.content[record.contentId]={...(store.content[record.contentId]||{}),status:'approved',updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}; return [{json:{contentId:record.contentId,status:'approved',caption:record.caption,visibility:record.contentId.startsWith('TEST-')?'CONNECTIONS':'PUBLIC'}}];

parameters.message: ={{ 'Content '+$json.contentId+' is now '+$json.status+'. Public publishing remains disabled until LinkedIn authorization and the private test are complete.' }}
